_help: Example values for a made-up person. Replace every value with your own (or say "profile setup" in Claude Code and it fills this in from your resume and accomplishments). Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.
headline: Software Engineer
summary: Software Engineer, Node.js/TypeScript backend, based in Portugal
_target_roles: Job titles to search for, most important first.
seniority: skip staff/principal/lead-only posts asking for 10+ years

stack.fit: Main backend is Node.js/TypeScript (NestJS/Express), or the post clearly accepts it
stack.skip: Go/Java/Python/Ruby/PHP-only backends, mobile, data science, DevOps-only and frontend-only roles

_domains: The industries and problem spaces of your past projects. Searches and outreach are built from these.

pay.note: Never below the minimum. Hourly = monthly / 160. Equity doesn't count toward the minimum.

remote: worldwide only: open to anywhere, or a country list that includes Portugal. EOR/contractor (Deel, Remote.com, Oyster) is fine
_company_countries: Where a company you apply or email to may be based (lowercase). Leave it out to use the default list in me.py.
company_countries_note: Europe (incl. UK), the USA, Australia, or a high-income Asian country.
_outreach_countries: Where a LinkedIn outreach person and their company may be (lowercase). Leave it out to use the default list in me.py.
outreach_countries_note: the USA, UK, Europe, Canada, Australia or Singapore
_blocked_countries: Never targeted, not even for a job you pick yourself (lowercase).
easy_time_zones: Europe, the UK and the US East Coast (within 5 hours of Portugal)
_job_search: Used by fetch_jobs.py and the job-apply skills. Words in title_* lists are regex pieces.

job_search.x_stack_query: (node OR nodejs OR "node.js" OR nestjs OR typescript) (backend OR "full stack")
